delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: auto: tab for .tsv-like files, else the delimiter that splits the first lines most evenly. A fixed value overrides detection.

colorCount.title: Colours before the palette repeats
colorCount.description: How many different colours to cycle through across columns. 2 to 8. Each column keeps its colour all the way down, header row included.

highlightColumn.title: Highlight the column under the caret
highlightColumn.description: Mark the cells of the caret's column, plus the row it is on.

maxSizeKb.title: Skip files larger than (KB)
maxSizeKb.description: Colour only files up to this size; larger files stay uncoloured so typing stays fast. 0 disables the limit.
